final_text:
All the fixes are in and the whole library now runs clean under ASan, UBSan and TSan. They're uncommitted in `src/ticks.cpp` and `include/ticks.hpp`.

My test harness failed on the original code in all 11 cases under ASan+UBSan, and all 11 pass on the fixed code. They also pass under TSan and under ASan+UBSan with libstdc++ debug mode (`_GLIBCXX_DEBUG`). No sanitizer was disabled and no suppressions were added. It builds with no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow`, and the CMake build works. Only GCC 14 was tested, because clang isn't installed here.

| Function | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `upper_ticker` | Returned a view of a destroyed local string | **Now returns `std::string`**, the only signature change; a view can't own the result, and callers keep it after `in` is gone |
| `append_negated` | `push_back` invalidated the iterators in use | Index loop over the original size, after `reserve` |
| `mix_hash` | Signed overflow | Computed in `uint32_t`, then converted to `int32_t` |
| `read_price` | Misaligned read and type punning | Builds the value byte by byte, then `bit_cast`; this also makes it little-endian on any host |
| `count_ticks` | Data race on `total` | `std::atomic<long>` |
| `Book::best` | Dereferenced `end()` on an empty book | Throws `std::out_of_range` |
| `Book::add_and_improvement` | Reference left dangling when `add` reallocated | Copies the previous price first |
| `rolling_mean` | Out-of-bounds iterator when `w > size`, read of `values[size]`, division by zero when `w == 0` | Early return and a corrected loop |
| `archive_label` | Used `name` after moving from it, giving a wrong label (not UB, but a real bug) | Builds the label before the move |
| `low_mask` | Shift by 64, and by a negative amount | Handled explicitly |
| `middle_word` | Returned a reference to a local; also indexed into an empty vector | `thread_local` buffer, because a plain `static` would race; throws on empty input |

**Behaviour the comments didn't define (now documented in the header):**
- **Nothing to return:** `best()`, `add_and_improvement()` and `middle_word()` throw `std::out_of_range`. An `add_and_improvement()` on an empty book throws before adding, so the book stays unchanged.
- **No valid window:** `rolling_mean` returns an empty vector when `w == 0` or `w > size`.
- **Out-of-range `bits`:** `low_mask` clamps the value to 0..64.
- **`middle_word` lifetime:** "valid until the next call" now means the next call on the same thread, and the reference doesn't outlive that thread.

**Left as is:**
- **NaN prices:** a NaN `px` in a `Book` breaks the ordering `max_element` requires. It's harmless in practice, and the header doesn't say how NaN should rank.
- **`count_ticks` thread failures:** if creating a thread fails, the program still terminates through `std::thread`'s destructor. That isn't UB.

The repo has no test suite, so I kept the harness out of it. It's at `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-hadriensuper-testLLM--work-runs-cpp-ub-hunt-claude-r1/88ea59e3-4d57-4998-a7e6-adea7f7779e8/scratchpad/check.cpp`, and that scratchpad is temporary.
